papers.title: Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning
papers.summary: Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning automatically balances one-step and multi-step returns by extending targets only when the critic values a dataset action at least as highly as the best-of-N actions from a behavior-cloning policy, improving long-horizon off-policy value learning.
